name: Worktree tasks
description: Run a coding task in a separate Git checkout and review its native conversation.
author: Modera
agentGuidance: When the user asks for a separate worktree task, call worktree_draft with a short title and concrete instruction. This saves a draft only. The user selects the base branch and execution model in the Worktree workbench and explicitly starts the task; do not run or merge it yourself.

tools.title: Draft a worktree task
tools.description: Save a reviewable coding task for an isolated Git worktree. It does not start execution.
